entry.title: Dub Force Siren 2.1.0
entry.summary: Dub Force Siren 2.1.0 fixes physical Q-Links on Track Edit → Automation and unstable WAVE/LFO SHAPE selection. All twelve factory sounds are now available in the native top-bar PRESET selector. The duplicate PATCH panel is removed, Q-Link 15 is unassigned and OUTPUT remains on 16. PITCH now spans 10 Hz–8 kHz logarithmically; with full LFO depth the siren sweep reaches 16 kHz. Existing normalized PITCH automation changes scale: review it before reusing old projects. Factory sounds and physical-Hz

entry.title: Dub Force Siren 2.0.0
entry.summary: Native ARM dub siren with tape echo for Akai Force / MPC OS. One page mirroring two banks of eight Q-Links: siren and zap modes, LFO, filter, ping-pong echo, twelve presets. Unzip on the device and run install.sh as root; see INSTALL.md inside the ZIP. Projects from 1.0.x reopen with their state migrated; 1.0.x automation does not carry over.
